implementation: Two zero-C BF16 matrix products supply signed and absolute K16 terms. The existing ordered projection interval retains its original2^-19 native allowance and canonical alignment/normalization envelope. Only identical BF16 consumer endpoints are admitted. WU preserves ownership across all rows of each16-column V tile; state admits W times H only if both BF16 difference and decayed difference agree; final FP32 state products and FMA remain original scalar arithmetic. Output certifies the original two multiplications and final FMA together. Every ambiguous or exceptional result uses original scalar replay. Unique per-CTA counters avoid contended global atomics and verify complete coverage and unchanged unused tails.
correctness_scope: All raw outputs, final FP32 state, W/U, BF16 checkpoints and residuals match the original scalar algorithm, including U=V, immutable input buffers and guards. Independent CPU columns check complete equations for finite and zero inputs; subnormal cases retain the original full GPU comparison. Native diagnostics cover72 safety reports and four complete8192 variants through every warmup and measured attempt. Host consumer intervals enumerate every representable point in narrow ranges crossing BF16 midpoints; native WMMA envelope validity is checked by these finite cases, not claimed as a universal hardware proof. No new GB10 operator or token boundary is measured.
timing_scope: The full8192 clock includes shared input preparation, WU, complete state recurrence, output, interval evaluation, exact replay, per-CTA counters and same-stream event recording. Events resolve only after final completion. Uploads, allocations, resets and validation are excluded. Production uses1024-row segmentation. Phase medians are diagnostics and must not be summed into a joint median. Safety timing fields are zero placeholders with events disabled.
decision: Keep the route isolated. Despite67048466/67108864 WU,33554399/33554432 state-residual and32681203/33554432 output admissions, the joint clock does not improve consistently: baseline/candidate83.4152/82.4457ms with separate U and78.5124/84.2312ms with U=V. WU improves from13.15-13.20 to7.48ms, while state regresses from38.54-40.01 to51.48-52.86ms. Output improves modestly to23.08-23.81ms. High admission rate alone does not establish efficient execution. Investigate a broader exact carry-transfer route for dominant dense projection replay; retain all product and GB10 gates.
